The frontend is built with React, react-router-dom, Redux with redux-thunk, Material-UI and react-bootstrap. App.js sets up the shell and the client-side routes for the homepage, login, signup, individual item pages and the cart. Components cover the homepage with its product cards and carousel, the navbar and footer, the product detail page and the cart. Small custom hooks handle form fields, toggles and the active user. The active user comes from a JWT stored in localStorage and decoded with jwt-decode.

The backend is an Express app configured with body parsing, CORS, and auth, products and cart routers. Requests are authenticated by middleware that verifies a JWT sent in the 'token' header. Tokens are issued by a small generator with a two-day expiry. Data is stored in PostgreSQL through a shared pg Pool wrapper, with connection settings read from environment variables or DATABASE_URL. node-pg-migrate migrations create the users, products and carts tables. The migrations appear in two places (server/database/migrations and server/migrations), which may be duplication.
